title: Existence of the concrete Godement cosimplicial operators
statement: There exist a cosimplicial object with Godement iterates, unit-insertion cofaces and multiplication codegeneracies.

proof.text: Construct the stalk/product-skyscraper adjunction. Identify its monad unit and multiplication with the concrete formulas by projection and stalk evaluation. The triangle identities and counit naturality give the unit and associativity laws. Insert the unit and multiplication in iterates; the monad identities imply the simplex relations, which extend these operators to a functor by the surjection/injection normal form. The degree terms and prescribed cofaces and codegeneracies follow from the construction.

lean.statement:
theorem moduleCup_godement_cosimplicial_exists (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) :
    ∃ (A : CosimplicialObject X.Modules)
      (h : ∀ n : ℕ, A.obj ⦋n⦌ = moduleCup_godementIterate X F (n + 1)),
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 2)),
        eqToHom (h n) ≫ moduleCup_godementInsert X F (n + 1) i =
          A.map (SimplexCategory.δ i) ≫ eqToHom (h (n + 1))) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)),
        eqToHom (h (n + 1)) ≫ moduleCup_godementCollapse X F n i =
          A.map (SimplexCategory.σ i) ≫ eqToHom (h n))
